definitions.explanation: The act of murdering a politically important or prominent person, typically for political or ideological reasons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大統領|だいとうりょう}→大統領：03418_daitouryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{暗殺|あんさつ}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{暗殺|あんさつ}⟦{未遂|みすい}→未遂：13085_misui⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was arrested for attempted assassination.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{暗殺|あんさつ}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: In history class, we learned about the assassination of famous politicians.

notes:
FORMS:
{暗|あん} (dark, secret) + {殺|さつ} (kill). Literally "secret killing."

USAGE:
Specifically refers to the murder of prominent figures (politicians, leaders, public figures) for political or ideological reasons. Does not apply to ordinary murders.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暗殺|あんさつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to assassinate
- {暗殺|あんさつ}⟦{未遂|みすい}→未遂：13085_misui⟧: attempted assassination
- {暗殺|あんさつ}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧: assassination incident
- {暗殺|あんさつ}{者|しゃ}: assassin
- {暗殺|あんさつ}⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧: assassination plot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {暗殺|あんさつ}: assassination (political murder)
- ⟦{殺人|さつじん}→殺人：13236_satsujin⟧: murder, homicide (general)
- {謀殺|ぼうさつ}: premeditated murder (legal term)
